cs_CZ.text: Čtyři automaty na kořist (běžný svět, Nether, zkušební komory, End) prodávají kořist ze stvoření, kterou při mírumilovné obtížnosti nezískáte. Vyžaduje základní balíček Vending Machines.

es_ES.text: Cuatro máquinas de botín (mundo superior, Inframundo, cámaras de prueba y End) que venden el botín de criaturas que no se consigue en dificultad Pacífico. Requiere el núcleo de Vending Machines.

es_MX.text: Cuatro máquinas de botín (Mundo principal, Nether, cámara de desafíos, End) que venden el botín de criaturas que no se consigue en dificultad pacífica. Requiere el núcleo de Vending Machines.

pt_PT.text: Quatro Máquinas de Saques (Superfície, Nether, Câmaras da Provação, End) que vendem os saques de criaturas impossíveis de obter na dificuldade Pacífico. Requer a base de Vending Machines.

pt_BR.text: Quatro Máquinas de Saque (Mundo Superior, Nether, Desafio, End) que vendem o saque de criaturas impossível de obter na dificuldade Pacífico. Requer a base de Vending Machines.

de_DE.text: Vier Beuteautomaten (Oberwelt, Nether, Prüfungskammern, Ende) verkaufen Kreaturenbeute, die eine Welt auf „Friedlich“ nicht liefert. Benötigt Vending Machines – Basis.

fr_FR.text: Quatre distributeurs de butin (Surface, Nether, salles d'épreuve, End) qui vendent le butin de créatures impossible à obtenir en difficulté Paisible. Nécessite Vending Machines — Base.

pl_PL.text: Cztery automaty z łupami (Nadziemie, Nether, komnaty prób, Kres) sprzedają łupy z mobów, których nie zdobędziesz na pokojowym poziomie trudności. Wymaga paczki Vending Machines — Podstawa.

machine.meaning: Automated shop using villager profession trade tables; never an actual villager profession change.

upgrade.meaning: Upgrade Kit enables discounted trades. Villager tiers remain engine-managed.

regional.policy: Use each locale's vanilla Bedrock word (bedrock-localization mc_terms.py), e.g. es_ES and es_MX both Valla/Albañil; Portugal Talhante and partilhado; Brazil Açougueiro and compartilhado.

vanilla_reference.status: Documented sample terminology, not checked in game. Installed extracted 1.26.52 .lang files are empty.

professions.meaning: Use vanilla Bedrock profession names. Owner decision 2026-11-21: machine names never use a colon, in any language; every machine is 'machine of <profession/loot/shulker>' in the language's natural form (cs genitive Automat farmáře, pl genitive Automat rolnika, de compound Bauern-Automat, fr Distributeur du fermier, es/pt Máquina de ...).

style.audience: Minecraft players; concise UI and gentle woodland narrative where applicable.
style.address: Czech respectful plural address; Spanish tú; Portuguese Portugal tu, Brazil você; German du; French vous (as vanilla Bedrock); Polish ty. Avoid assuming player gender.
style.review: AI draft, not independently language-reviewed or tested in game.
style.reference: Locale list verified in installed 1.26.52 reference. Vanilla terminology checked against Mojang bedrock-samples commit 46ba6ea985fb5a92d79a9419198f10dda14c199d; sample terms documented, not checked in game.
